task: T3: poll for a control intent and honour a cancel, in scripts/ralph-build.sh. Between attempts and between tasks — the two moments the loop is between units of work and can act without abandoning anything in flight — GET `{base}/runs/{run_key}/control` and read an action from the JSON answer. When the action is `cancel`, stop the run cleanly: stamp a terminal phase on the heartbeat so the run does not freeze mid-record claiming to be running, say plainly on stdout that it was cancelled, and exit non-zero with a status distinct from a gate failure, because a cancelled run is not a failed one and a reader must be able to tell them apart. Every other case means carry on: no URL configured, an unreachable coordinator, a timeout, a non-2xx answer, a body that does not parse, an action that is absent or unrecognised. Fail OPEN on the channel and CLOSED on the intent — a coordinator being down must never stop a build, and an answer that cannot be read must never be treated as a cancel. Bound the call. Do not implement pause here; T4 owns it.
